title: Spooky Vibes Music Bingo + Costume Contest
theme: Spooky Vibes Music Bingo + Costume Contest
shortDescription: Spooky-season Music Bingo plus a costume contest at Boze’s.
description: Your costume deserves a night out. Join Four Dogs at Boze’s for Spooky Vibes Music Bingo and a costume contest. Bring your people, dress for the occasion, and settle in for a Wednesday night of familiar music and Halloween fun.
instructions: Check with the venue for admission, seating, and participation details before attending.
